dct_description_sm: Contained within the 5th Edition (1978 to 1995) of the National Atlas of Canada is a plate comprised of 7 maps. The largest map shows the oil and gas fields, pipelines and processing facilities. One of two other large maps, coal and uranium, shows known and potential mining areas and existing mines for each mineral (1976); the other large map, electricity, shows electric power stations and transmission lines, and has data on potential tidal power sites (1976). Small maps show solar energy (1968), wind energy (1977), and heating degree-days (1941 to 1970 data). Flows map shows interprovincial energy flows (1974). The world map shows energy consumption for six world regions (1974). The tables give Canadian energy production and consumption (1974), historical supply and demand (1960 to 1974), and energy demand projections (1980 to 1990).
